app.name: Telegram CRM
app.tagline: Manage your Telegram shop and orders
app.errorGeneric: We could not reach the server. Please try again.

auth.outsideTelegramDesc: This app is designed for Telegram. Browse any public storefront below or open the app from Telegram to sign in.
auth.reopenDesc: Please sign in again or re-open this Mini App from Telegram.
auth.devInitDataPlaceholder: Paste signed Telegram initData query string
auth.selectShopDesc: Select which shop you want to manage.

onboarding.title: Create your shop
onboarding.subtitle: Launch your Telegram storefront and CRM in seconds.
onboarding.slugHelper: Lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens only (3-40 chars)
onboarding.validationName: Shop name must be between 2 and 120 characters.
onboarding.validationSlug: Address must be 3-40 lowercase letters, digits, or hyphens.

merchant.copyFailed: Could not copy automatically. Please copy the link manually.

dashboard.title: Shop overview
dashboard.noRecentOrders: No orders have been placed yet.
dashboard.noRecentOrdersHint: Share your shop link in your Telegram channel to start receiving orders.

catalog.title: Products & Categories
catalog.emptyProducts: No products yet. Add your first product to get started.
catalog.needCategoryFirst: Create at least one category before adding products.
catalog.editStockHint: Use the Stock button on the product card to adjust inventory.
catalog.deltaLabel: Delta (positive to add, negative to deduct)
catalog.uploadImageLabel: Choose image (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF up to 5 MB)
catalog.emptyImages: No images uploaded for this product yet.
catalog.deleteCategoryInUse: This category still has products and cannot be deleted.
catalog.deleteProductInUse: This product appears in orders; deactivate it instead of deleting.
catalog.slugTaken: This URL path is already in use.
catalog.confirmDeleteProduct: Delete product "{{name}}"? This action cannot be undone.
catalog.invalidFileType: Unsupported file type. Use JPEG, PNG, WebP, or GIF.
catalog.fileTooLarge: File size must not exceed 5 MB.
catalog.validationName: Name must be at least 2 characters.
catalog.validationSlug: Path may only contain lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens.
catalog.validationPrice: Price must be a valid non-negative number.
catalog.validationStock: Stock must be a valid non-negative integer.
catalog.validationDelta: Stock adjustment must be a non-zero integer.

customers.title: Customers & Tags
customers.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, username, or phone...
customers.empty: No customers recorded in this shop yet.
customers.emptyHint: Customers who place orders in your storefront are added automatically, or you can add one manually.
customers.telegramIdHelper: Storefront buyers are added automatically; enter a numeric Telegram ID for manual entry.
customers.customerExists: A customer with this Telegram ID already exists.
customers.noOrders: This customer has not placed any orders yet.
customers.validationTelegramId: Telegram ID must be a positive integer.
customers.validationUsername: Username must be 4-32 letters, digits, or underscores starting with a letter.

settings.title: Shop Settings
settings.subtitle: Manage your shop profile, branding, and storefront details.
settings.profileDesc: Configure your shop name, default language, and display currency.
settings.brandingDesc: Upload your shop logo and a fallback image for products without photos.
settings.logoHint: Displayed in your storefront and dashboard header (max 5 MB).
settings.defaultProductImageHint: Shown in your storefront whenever a product has no photos.
settings.shopInfoDesc: Helpful contact and shipping details stored for your shop.
settings.storeBioPlaceholder: e.g. Specialty coffee and gear with daily shipping
settings.shippingNotePlaceholder: e.g. Same-day courier locally, express post nationwide
settings.advancedDesc: Use only if you need extra custom fields.

storefront.emptyProducts: No active products are available in this shop yet.
storefront.shopNotFoundDesc: This shop link is invalid or the shop is currently inactive.
storefront.myOrdersLoginRequired: Open this storefront inside Telegram to view your orders.
storefront.myOrdersEmpty: You have not placed any orders in this shop yet.
storefront.productNotFoundDesc: This product is no longer active or does not exist.
storefront.cartValid: All items and prices are verified.
storefront.cartHasIssues: Some items in your cart need attention.
storefront.issueUnavailable: This product is no longer available.
storefront.phoneInvalid: Please enter a valid phone number (e.g. +989121234567).
storefront.notePlaceholder: Delivery address, preferred time, or special instructions...
storefront.loginToCheckoutTitle: Sign in to place your order
storefront.loginToCheckoutDesc: Your cart is saved. Open this Mini App inside Telegram or sign in to complete checkout.
storefront.cancelOrderConfirmDesc: Only Pending orders can be cancelled. Stock will be restored automatically.
storefront.orderNotFoundDesc: This order does not exist or does not belong to your account.
